Only the owner can change the betLimit.
An address that is not the owner cannot change the betLimit.
After any non-owner changes betLimit, the stored betLimit must stay equal to its initial value.
A failed non-owner call to AdjustBetAmounts must either revert or leave betLimit unchanged.
Only the owner can change betLimit; a non-owner call to AdjustBetAmounts leaves betLimit unchanged in the reference but changes it in the mutant.

For any caller, after a successful call to AdjustBetAmounts(x), betLimit equals x in the reference, but the mutant allows non-owners to change betLimit, violating that the new betLimit equals the argument when the caller is not the owner.

The reference C only allows the owner to change betLimit via AdjustBetAmounts, so a call by any non-owner leaves betLimit unchanged; the buggy version allows any caller to change betLimit, violating the invariant that betLimit stays constant after a non-owner call.
For any call to AdjustDifficulty by the owner, the currentDifficulty after the call must equal the argument amount.
A successful call to AdjustDifficulty by the owner must not revert.
Only the owner can successfully call AdjustDifficulty, and any non-owner call must revert.
